title: Autonomous Application Shield: scans, recommended controls and scan reports

prose.text: The AppProtection controls it assigns are in [[zpa.appprotection.controls]]. The scan settings, control statuses, licence and interaction with a profile are open {{gap:scan-settings}} {{gap:profile-interaction}}.

checks.do: Whether App Connectors are designated as App Scanners and a scan profile and scan exist before expecting recommended controls.
Whether Auto Application Shield is still enabled on the application segment, since it is enabled by default and can be disabled.

overview.statement: Autonomous Application Shield uses AI to identify risks in private applications: they are scanned at a specific scanning intensity and time, the scan reports are forwarded to the Zscaler cloud AI system, and existing AppProtection controls are then assigned to application segments to monitor or block vulnerabilities.

quotes: Autonomous Application Shield uses AI to identify risks in private applications in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Private applications are scanned based on a specific scanning intensity and time, and these scan reports are forwarded to the Zscaler cloud AI system.
Existing AppProtection controls are then assigned to application segments to monitor or block vulnerabilities.

prerequisites.statement: Before using Autonomous Application Shield, App Connectors must be designated as App Scanners, a scan profile created and a scan created.

quotes: Before using Autonomous Application Shield, make sure that you have designated App Connectors as App Scanners, created a scan profile, and created a scan.

protection-page.statement: The Protection page shows the threat severity levels found while scanning the applications, the number of recommended AppProtection controls and the number deployed for the scan; clicking an application segment shows its AppProtection controls, each with a Control Type (Predefined or ThreatLabZ), a Status (for example Deployed), an Applications Count and a CVEs Count.

quotes: Severity: The threat severity levels that were found while scanning the applications.
Recommended Controls Count: The number of recommended AppProtection controls.
Deployed Controls Count: The number of AppProtection controls deployed for the scan.
Click an application segment to view its AppProtection controls.
Status: The status of the AppProtection control (e.g., Deployed).

evidence.after: About the Autonomous Application Shield Protection Page
quotes: Control Type: The type of AppProtection control (Predefined or ThreatLabZ).
Applications Count: The number of applications using the AppProtection control.
CVEs Count: The number of common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVE) that have been detected.

assessment-findings.statement: A control's assessment findings include the CVE ID, the detected date and the CVSS score.

evidence.after: About the Autonomous Application Shield Protection Page
quotes: CVE ID: The identification number for the CVE.
Detected Date: The date that the vulnerability was detected.
CVSS: The Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) score.

configure-protection.statement: Auto Application Shield is enabled by default and can be disabled from the application segment. Each control's action is Monitor, which monitors the applications associated with that threat, or Block, which blocks them.

quotes: Auto Application Shield: This option is enabled by default. Click Disabled to disable the Auto Application Shield feature from the application segment.
Monitor: The AppProtection control monitors the applications associated with that threat.
Block: The AppProtection control blocks the applications associated with that threat.

scan-status.statement: On the Scan Status page the list of application segments shows, for each, a Scan ID, Status, Start Time, End Time, Applications and CVEs Count; clicking an application segment shows its App Scanners, each with the associated App Scanner for the scan and a Scan Interval.

evidence.after: About the Autonomous Application Shield Scan Status Page
quotes: View a list of application segments. For each application segment, you can view:
Scan ID: The identification number for the scan.
Start Time: The time the scan began.
End Time: The time the scan ended.

evidence.after: Scan ID: The identification number for the scan.
quotes: Status: The status of the scan.
Applications: The applications associated with the scan.
CVEs Count: The number of CVEs that have been detected.

evidence.after: Click an application segment to view its App Scanners.
quotes: App Scanner: The associated App Scanner for the scan.
Scan Interval: When the scan began and ended.

report-downloads.statement: A scan report is downloaded with Download Report in CSV or PDF format, and the scan information details are downloaded into a JSON file with the Download icon.

quotes: Click Download Report to download the scan report in either a CSV or PDF format.
Click the Download icon to download the scan information details into a JSON file.

scan-settings.title: Scan settings, statuses and licence
scan-settings.detail: The page does not give the scanning intensity values, scan profile settings, scan statuses, what control statuses other than Deployed mean, or the licence. The scan profile and App Scanner configuration articles are not in this area.

profile-interaction.title: How Auto Application Shield's control assignment interacts with an AppProtection profile
profile-interaction.detail: The page says existing AppProtection controls are assigned to application segments and does not say how that interacts with an existing AppProtection profile.
